review_candidates.description: Assistant to Chief Executive Officer Foresight is a financial group that creates and develops a range of financial products and services through its subsidiaries, including financial institutions licensed by the National Bank of Georgia. We are looking for an Assistant to Chief Executive Officer to support the Group CEO in driving the Group’s projects and priorities, keeping work on track across teams, and turning decisions into action. The role offers a unique opportunity to start a career at the center of a growing financial group, with direct exposure to senior management and strategic decision-making. Key responsibilities Project tracking. Monitoring ongoing Group projects, collecting status updates from teams, and preparing concise progress reports and dashboards for the CEO. Task management. Scheduling and prioritizing tasks, tracking deadlines and deliverables, and following up with responsible teams to ensure timely execution. Meetings and decisions. Preparing agendas and briefing materials for management meetings, recording decisions and action points, and following through on their implementation. Analysis and preparation. Gathering information, conducting research and analysis, and preparing presentations, memos, and reports in Georgian and English. Coordination. Acting as a link between the CEO, management, and subsidiaries, aligning priorities and keeping information flowing across the Group. Strategic support. Supporting the CEO on special projects and new initiatives, from planning through execution. What we’re looking for Education. Final-year Bachelor’s student, recent graduate, or Master’s student in Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. Mindset. Curious, proactive, and eager to learn, with a strong sense of ownership and a drive to see things through. Structured thinking. Ability to organize information, set priorities, and break complex tasks into clear, manageable steps. Analytical ability. Comfort working with numbers and data, and the ability to turn them into clear, concise updates and presentations. Communication. Excellent written and verbal communication in Georgian and English. Tools. Strong proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with project management tools is an advantage. Personal qualities. Reliable, detail-oriented, and discreet, able to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Prior work experience is not required; internships or university projects are a plus. Selection process The selection process consists of two interviews. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. How to apply Send your CV in PDF format, preferably in Georgian or English, to info@foresight.ge , with the vacancy title in the subject line. Equal opportunity The company evaluates candidates solely on the basis of their qualifications and skills. Discrimination on any grounds is excluded from the selection process, in compliance with the Law of Georgia on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination. Personal data The company processes candidates’ personal data to assess their suitability for the vacancy, in accordance with the Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection. Candidate information may also be processed to assess suitability for future vacancies and is retained for no longer than one year. To object to further processing, or to request that your data be corrected or deleted or its processing stopped, please contact pdp.officer@foresight.ge .
